__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: espressolab Postgres
__inputs.description: Postgres+TimescaleDB datasource pointing at the espressolab database

list.name: shot_id
list.label: Shot
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, started_at::text || '  ·  ' || coalesce(drinker_name, 'unattributed') AS __text FROM shots ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS shots_today FROM shots WHERE started_at >= date_trunc('day', now())
SELECT avg(duration_seconds) AS avg_duration FROM shots WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT coalesce(u.display_name, s.drinker_name, 'unattributed') AS person, count(*) AS shots FROM shots s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.started_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shots DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at)::date AS day, count(*) AS shots FROM shots WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(u.display_name, s.drinker_name, 'unattributed') AS person, count(*) AS shots FROM shots s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.started_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shots DESC
SELECT sample_time AS time, pressure, target_pressure, flow, target_flow, weight FROM shot_samples WHERE shot_id = '$shot_id' ORDER BY sample_time

SELECT s.started_at, coalesce(u.display_name, s.drinker_name, 'unattributed') AS person, s.coffee_name, s.coffee_roaster, s.target_dose_weight, s.actual_yield, s.duration_seconds, s.drink_tds, s.drink_ey, s.enjoyment, s.espresso_notes FROM shots s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 100
